Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Tier placements: d4builds S, drawn first among the Rogue S builds; Maxroll push S, the first entry of the whole list; Maxroll endgame A and speedfarm A. It is the meta under the site-wide tie-break (d4builds tier → d4builds listing order → InfinityBuilds → Maxroll, push before endgame). Disagreement, stated plainly: InfinityBuilds does not rank Penetrating Shot at all and rates Cold Rain of Arrows S on both its endgame and its pushing list. On a list-by-list count Rain of Arrows is S on four of five lists and Penetrating Shot on two; Maxroll endgame puts Dance of Knives above both. d4builds and Maxroll agree on the frame: Leoric's Crown with Hellfire + Pain, Eaglehorn, Etna's Lost Dagger, Aspect of Imitated Imbuement on the second dagger, Aspect of Mending Obscurity boots, five Sightless charms + Cowl of the Nameless, Preparation, Concealment on the bar, Subo + Varyana, and identical boards and glyphs. They disagree on the chest (d4builds Squirt's Blouse; Maxroll an Aspect of Debilitating Toxins legendary), gloves (d4builds Fist of the Iron Rose; Maxroll Fists of Fate), pants (d4builds a Debilitating Toxins legendary; Maxroll Tibault's Will), amulet (d4builds Ferocious; Maxroll Blood-Mad Idol at push, Crushing at midgame), rings (d4builds Writhing + Scoundrel's Kiss; Maxroll Malice + Writhing at push) and tempers (d4builds Imbuement Potency; Maxroll Damage Over Time). Late endgame follows d4builds, pushing follows Maxroll's Push profile. Hellfire costs this build little: its offensive affixes are Damage Over Time, Vulnerable and All Damage Multipliers with Imbuement Potency or Damage Over Time tempers, and d4builds rolls no Critical Strike affix, so Splinter of Hellfire's −100% Critical Strike Chance takes away a stat the loadout does not buy (whether damage over time can critically strike at all is not in the knowledge base, unverified). 3.2.1: no Penetrating Shot skill line; the Combo Points damage-reduction bug on Penetrating Shot is fixed; Imbuement Potency now works for Shadow Clones with Etna's Lost Dagger; Aspect of Corruption is now multiplicative. Soul Splinters: every reference runs five (two in Leoric's Crown plus amulet and both rings) against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap is unpublished — re-verify. Specialization has no schema field, so each stage names it as its first skill priority.

Rotation
  1. Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, alternate Concealment and Shadow Clone for the Sightless set bonus, spam Penetrating Shot off walls, Dash to move.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Poison and Shadow Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow to build, Penetrating Shot down lines of enemies, Dash and Shadow Step to reposition.
Move on when At level 70 with Eaglehorn and Etna's Lost Dagger, respec to the Midgame bar (Shadow Clone, Concealment, Preparation).

Early Endgame — Shadow Clone on cooldown for Vulnerable, Concealment before big pulls, Penetrating Shot into walls.
Move on when Move to the d4builds layout when you own Leoric's Crown, Fist of the Iron Rose, Scoundrel's Kiss, Squirt's Blouse and Cowl of the Nameless as the sixth charm.

Late Endgame — Maintain Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud. Alternate between Concealment and Shadow Clone for the Linta of the Sightless set bonus. Spam Penetrating Shot. Dash for mobility. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when Leoric's Crown, Eaglehorn, Etna's Lost Dagger and Scoundrel's Kiss are Mythic and a charm carries the Lucky Hit elemental roll Etna's needs. d4builds' defensive swap: Squirt's Blouse → Aspect of Disobedience.

Pushing — Poison Trap replaces Shadow Step for Tricks of the Trade's Trap category (3.2.1 bug fix counts Poison Trap); otherwise as late_endgame: Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, alternate Concealment and Shadow Clone, spam Penetrating Shot, Dash to move.

How to run them

d4builds (2026-09-16): hire Subo, reinforce with Varyana casting Bloodthirst on Skill Cast. Maxroll: Subo / Varyana, Bloodthirst on Penetrating Shot; its Leveling 1-70 profile hires Raheir. Hired-mercenary skill picks did not decode reliably, so none are listed.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Tier placements: d4builds S, drawn first among the Rogue S builds; Maxroll push S, the first entry of the whole list; Maxroll endgame A and speedfarm A. It is the meta under the site-wide tie-break (d4builds tier → d4builds listing order → InfinityBuilds → Maxroll, push before endgame). Disagreement, stated plainly: InfinityBuilds does not rank Penetrating Shot at all and rates Cold Rain of Arrows S on both its endgame and its pushing list. On a list-by-list count Rain of Arrows is S on four of five lists and Penetrating Shot on two; Maxroll endgame puts Dance of Knives above both. d4builds and Maxroll agree on the frame: Leoric's Crown with Hellfire + Pain, Eaglehorn, Etna's Lost Dagger, Aspect of Imitated Imbuement on the second dagger, Aspect of Mending Obscurity boots, five Sightless charms + Cowl of the Nameless, Preparation, Concealment on the bar, Subo + Varyana, and identical boards and glyphs. They disagree on the chest (d4builds Squirt's Blouse; Maxroll an Aspect of Debilitating Toxins legendary), gloves (d4builds Fist of the Iron Rose; Maxroll Fists of Fate), pants (d4builds a Debilitating Toxins legendary; Maxroll Tibault's Will), amulet (d4builds Ferocious; Maxroll Blood-Mad Idol at push, Crushing at midgame), rings (d4builds Writhing + Scoundrel's Kiss; Maxroll Malice + Writhing at push) and tempers (d4builds Imbuement Potency; Maxroll Damage Over Time). Late endgame follows d4builds, pushing follows Maxroll's Push profile. Hellfire costs this build little: its offensive affixes are Damage Over Time, Vulnerable and All Damage Multipliers with Imbuement Potency or Damage Over Time tempers, and d4builds rolls no Critical Strike affix, so Splinter of Hellfire's −100% Critical Strike Chance takes away a stat the loadout does not buy (whether damage over time can critically strike at all is not in the knowledge base, unverified). 3.2.1: no Penetrating Shot skill line; the Combo Points damage-reduction bug on Penetrating Shot is fixed; Imbuement Potency now works for Shadow Clones with Etna's Lost Dagger; Aspect of Corruption is now multiplicative. Soul Splinters: every reference runs five (two in Leoric's Crown plus amulet and both rings) against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap is unpublished — re-verify. Specialization has no schema field, so each stage names it as its first skill priority.

Rotation
  1. Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, alternate Concealment and Shadow Clone for the Sightless set bonus, spam Penetrating Shot off walls, Dash to move.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Poison and Shadow Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow to build, Penetrating Shot down lines of enemies, Dash and Shadow Step to reposition.
Move on when At level 70 with Eaglehorn and Etna's Lost Dagger, respec to the Midgame bar (Shadow Clone, Concealment, Preparation).

Early Endgame — Shadow Clone on cooldown for Vulnerable, Concealment before big pulls, Penetrating Shot into walls.
Move on when Move to the d4builds layout when you own Leoric's Crown, Fist of the Iron Rose, Scoundrel's Kiss, Squirt's Blouse and Cowl of the Nameless as the sixth charm.

Late Endgame — Maintain Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud. Alternate between Concealment and Shadow Clone for the Linta of the Sightless set bonus. Spam Penetrating Shot. Dash for mobility. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when Leoric's Crown, Eaglehorn, Etna's Lost Dagger and Scoundrel's Kiss are Mythic and a charm carries the Lucky Hit elemental roll Etna's needs. d4builds' defensive swap: Squirt's Blouse → Aspect of Disobedience.

Pushing — Poison Trap replaces Shadow Step for Tricks of the Trade's Trap category (3.2.1 bug fix counts Poison Trap); otherwise as late_endgame: Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, alternate Concealment and Shadow Clone, spam Penetrating Shot, Dash to move.
